claim: MTD aims to shift the advantage of time from the attacker to the defender.
quote: In cyber space, attackers have an asymmet­ ric advantage in that they have time to study our networks to determine potential vulnerabilities and choose the time of attack and gain the maximum beneﬁt.
locator: p. 1 (preprint PDF p. 1), Sec. 1; MTD's response at the same place: "the network constantly changes to reduce/shift the attack surface area avail­ able for exploitation by attackers", and Sec. 2.2, PDF p. 5: "an attacker must continually re-gain the knowledge and privi­ leges obtained through prior attacks"
issue: Zhuang et al. say attackers hold an advantage of time and that MTD shifts the attack surface so the attacker must keep re-gaining knowledge; they do not say MTD gives the time advantage to the defender. Supports the problem half and a weaker 'erodes the attacker's time advantage'; ghosh2009nitrd may carry the 'shift to the defender' wording (not checked here: one source per pass).
fix_text: Keep if ghosh2009nitrd carries the 'to the defender' half; otherwise "shift the advantage of time from the attacker to the defender" -> "take away the attacker's advantage of time".
